summary: Iteration 25 (Phase 1 bug fixes + Phase 2 client care-profile rework) verified end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/backend_iteration25_test.py — owner (TEST_USER_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD) login OK; GET /api/billing/membership returns {status:'trialing', plan:'trial', is_active:true, expires_at:2026-07-21}; POST /api/clients with care_sections [{title:'Communication',text:'Uses short sentences'},{title:'Mobility',text:'Wheelchair user'}] creates client and response contains NO condition/severity fields (verified); GET /clients/{id} returns care_sections intact and excludes _id; PATCH /clients/{id} with 3 replacement care_sections persists correctly (verified via subsequent GET); legacy condition/severity fields sent in POST body are silently ignored (not stored, not in response); POST /clients/{id}/notes + GET list regression passes (text/date/client_id/id fields correct, _id excluded); POST /account/reset-data (TEST_DEMO_EMAIL) returns {success:true, deleted:{...}} and afterwards GET /clients returns [] + GET /settings returns default 'Your Support Business'. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, real browser context): (1) FRESH LOGIN as owner in a clean localStorage state — onboarding walkthrough appears with 7 slide dots (verified: 6 successful 'Next' taps landed on last slide, onboarding-getstarted testID visible), last slide body text contained 'trial' / '14-day' copy, tapping 'Skip' routed to /dashboard. (2) Dashboard shows GREEN trial-banner testID with text '14 days left in your free trial · View plans' — tapping it routed to /membership showing 'Free 14-day trial' + 'Trial ends 21/07/2026 · 14 days left' (dd/mm/yyyy ✓). (3) Getting Started onboarding-checklist rendered with 'Getting Started · 0 of 4 done' and 'Set up your business profile' UNTICKED — matches the freshly-wiped settings state. After creating a client via the form the checklist auto-updated to '1 of 4 done' with 'Add your first client' ticked (green strikethrough, seen in follow-up screenshot). (4) Bogus route /this-does-not-exist correctly REDIRECTS to '/' (dashboard) — no expo-router 'Unmatched Route' page (body text check verified 'Unmatched Route' absent). (5) Account screen shows red DANGER ZONE with 'Start fresh — erase all data' row (account-reset-data testID, subtext 'Deletes every client, invoice, receipt, note & setting. Your account stays.'). NOT executed on owner to preserve the trial clock; equivalent flow verified via backend reset-data pytest on demo account. (6) New Client form: 'Condition/Disability' and 'Severity' fields ARE FULLY REMOVED (body text check both false). 'Care profile' section visible with suggestion chips care-chip-Communication / care-chip-Mobility / care-chip-Personal care (all FOUND) + care-chip-custom. Tapping Communication chip added editable section with testIDs care-title-0 (pre-filled 'Communication'), care-text-0 (editable) and care-remove-0 (trash) — all present. DOB DateInput auto-formatted '15031990' → '15/03/1990' ✓. Saved client successfully. (7) Client detail screen: Care Profile card renders with 'COMMUNICATION' (uppercase) title + 'Uses short sentences and gestures' text. (8) Today's Notes: tapped notes-preview to expand, typed 'Iter25 note - shift went great today' via notes-inline-input, blurred to persist, tapped notes-save-client-btn → client picker sheet opened with notes-client-{id} row → tapped client → note SAVED to client and Today's Notes TEXT CLEARED back to 'Jot down anything…' placeholder (verified via cache:/notes/2026-07-07 = {text:''} in localStorage). Backend logs clean. Console shows only pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, expo-notifications web token) — not iteration-25 regressions. React-native-keyboard-controller is native-only, not tested on web (per spec). Reset-data on OWNER was intentionally NOT executed to preserve the fresh trial state (test_credentials.md still valid). No blocking issues.

issues: DOB in the client-detail summary line renders as ISO '1990-03-15' (e.g. '36 yrs · 1990-03-15') instead of dd/mm/yyyy. Spec item 6 explicitly enforces dd/mm/yyyy across the app and the DOB *input* now uses the DD/MM/YYYY DateInput — for consistency the DOB display should also render dd/mm/yyyy (e.g. '15/03/1990'). Low priority, not called out in the review checklist. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/client/[id].tsx (header meta line combining age + date_of_birth).

action_items: OPTIONAL: format DOB on client-detail header as dd/mm/yyyy (currently shows ISO '1990-03-15' in the 'X yrs · YYYY-MM-DD' meta line). Consistency with iteration-25 dd/mm/yyyy enforcement. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/client/[id].tsx summary line.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2586-2613 /account/reset-data correctly loops through RESETTABLE_COLLECTIONS filtered by org_id, wipes settings via delete_one({_id: 'business::<org>'}), and ONLY the owner email restarts the 14-day trial + reverts plan to 'trial'/status 'trialing'. Legacy daily_notes keyed by _id prefix also cleaned.

server.py:1097-1118 Client + ClientCreate models correctly define care_sections: List[dict] with default_factory=list and NO 'condition' / 'severity' fields — legacy fields sent by clients are dropped by Pydantic (extra='ignore' via BaseModel default) and never surface in doc_out response. Verified in pytest test_create_client_ignores_legacy_condition_severity.

server.py:2664-2678 /billing/membership owner override: if trial has lapsed, auto-flip to lifetime — good UX safety net so the test/demo owner is never locked out. Trial still returns is_active:true correctly during 14-day window.
+not-found.tsx uses <Redirect href='/'> — clean, no flicker of 'Unmatched Route' observed; confirmed via body text scan.

OnboardingChecklist derives 'profile' from settings.abn OR non-default business_name — after /account/reset-data wipes settings, checklist correctly shows '0 of 4 done' with profile UNTICKED (verified). Auto-refresh via useFocusEffect picks up the new client and moves progress to '1 of 4' immediately.

NotesCard.saveToClient (line 45-54) awaits api.addClientNote then calls persist({text:''}) — the cleared state is persisted server-side (verified via /api/notes/2026-07-07 GET returning empty text). Nice: setPickerOpen(false) before persist so the sheet dismisses immediately and toast fires last.

ClientFormSheet care_sections implementation (lines 181-220): suggestion chips filter out already-added titles (prevents duplicates), 'Custom' chip pushes an empty {title,text} row, per-row testIDs correctly indexed (care-title-{i}/care-text-{i}/care-remove-{i}) — matches Playwright expectations.

Cosmetic: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/client/[id].tsx header meta likely still shows raw date_of_birth (ISO). Suggest wrapping with the DateInput formatter or a small util fmtDDMMYYYY(iso) for parity with membership/invoice/reminder rendering.
No file exceeds 700 lines: NotesCard.tsx 225 lines, ClientFormSheet.tsx 281 lines, OnboardingChecklist.tsx 121 lines, server.py client/reset/billing sections ~140 lines each — modular.
